Guidance: Enter a unique requirement identifier from the requirements documentation.
Enter the requirement description from the requirements documentation.
Enter the criteria for acceptance, stated so they can be judged as met or not met.
Describe the method of validating that the requirement meets the stakeholder's needs.
Optional. Record the verification method used to prove that the deliverable meets the requirement. Adding this column turns the form into a product verification, validation, and acceptance form.
Document whether the requirement or deliverable was accepted or not.
Obtain the signature of the party accepting the product.
Enter the date the product was accepted. This dates the acceptance for the project record and for the requirements traceability matrix.
Add any comments relevant to the acceptance, such as conditions attached to the acceptance, or items deferred to a later acceptance.
